arabic.span: إِنَّ مُبْغِضَكَ -يَا مُحَمَّدُ-وَمُبْغِضَ مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الْهُدَى وَالْحَقِّ وَالْبُرْهَانِ السَّاطِعِ وَالنُّورِ الْمُبِينِ، هُوَ الْأَبْتَرُ الْأَقَلُّ الْأَذَلُّ الْمُنْقَطِعُ ذكْرُه.

english.span: (For he who hates you, he will be cut off.) meaning, `indeed he who hates you, O Muhammad, and he hates what you have come with of guidance, truth, clear proof and manifest light, he is the most cut off, meanest, lowliest person who will not be remembered.

fidelity.controlled_summary: Ibn Kathir explains that Muhammad's hater, who rejects the guidance and clear proof he brought, is abased, cut off, and deprived of lasting remembrance.
aligned_elements: hostility toward the guidance, truth and clear proof he brought
